data.name: Kinnie
data.gender_notes: Kinnie is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek word ‘κεννη’, meaning ‘pure, innocent’. In Christian tradition, this name embodies the purity and innocence of the soul. The name Kinnie carries the meaning “Pure, Innocent” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kinnie usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, innocent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of spiritual purity and innocence.
data.etymology: Kinnie belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure, Innocent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kinnie total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: קיני
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קיני יצויר מעקבות השם היווני Κίννης. שמות ילדים כאלו, קשורים לכאב, אובדן, וסבל. בתרבות הנוצרית, שם זה עשוי לסמל תפקיד הילד בתהליך האדם לקבל אורח חיים קדוש.

in_greek.name: Κίννης
in_greek.long_meaning: ονομα Κίννης, προέρχεται από την αρχαία ελληνική γλώσσα, και σημαίνει Παρισμός, στέρηση, απαξίωση. στην χριστιανική παράδοση, ονομάζεται Κίννης, για να θυμίζει την έλλειψη και την ταπεινότητα. Κύτη η παράδοση, ενισχύει την ιδέα ότι η χριστιανική ζωή, είναι μια ζωή στερημένη από τα πλεονέκτηματα και τα κοσμικά επιPRIA.

in_latin.name: Kinnie
in_latin.long_meaning: nomen Kinnie, originem habet a Kinnen, quod significat desiderium, carencia. in traditione christiana, nomina Kinnie, ad memoriam desiderii et humilitatis ponuntur. haec traditio, confirmat ideam, quae christianam vitam, esse vitam desiderii et humilitatis.
